map.CI = x̄ ± z · s / √n；z 由置信水平按逆正态近似反解（双侧）: CI = x̄ ± z · s / √n, with z inverted from the confidence level by the normal approximation (two-sided)
map.均值置信区间以样本均值 x̄ 为中心，加上/减去 z 值乘标准误 s/√n。z: The confidence interval for a mean is centred on the sample mean x̄ plus or minus the z value times the standard error s/√n. The z value is inverted from the confidence level: taking the tail probability α = (1 − cl/100)/2 in the inverse standard normal approximation, 95% gives z ≈ 1.96 and 99% gives z ≈ 2.576. It applies to large samples or when the population standard deviation is known.
map.大样本或已知总体标准差时使用 Z 分布。: Use the z distribution for large samples or when the population standard deviation is known.
map.z=(x−μ)/σ 将数值转为标准分。: z=(x−μ)/σ turns a value into a standard score.
map.跨量纲比较、离群识别（|z|>3）。: Comparison across units and outlier detection (|z|>3).

map.置信区间（本页代码口径）：CI=x̄±z·s÷√n，z=normalInv((1: Confidence interval (as coded on this page): CI=x̄±z·s÷√n, z=normalInv((1+confidence level÷100)÷2) (Acklam rational approximation inverting the two-sided standard normal quantile); lower bound=x̄−z·s÷√n, upper bound=x̄+z·s÷√n. Validation: the four fields are mandatory via input guards and must be valid numbers, otherwise a prompt is shown and the calculation stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; at 95% confidence z≈1.96, and the interval widens with s and narrows with √n.

Criteria: no fixed grading; at 95% confidence z≈1.96, and the interval widens with s and narrows with √n.
map.置信区间判读（与上式互补）：CI=x̄±Z₁₋α/₂·s÷√n，α=1−置信水平: Confidence-interval interpretation (complements the formula above): CI=x̄±Z₁₋α/₂·s÷√n, α=1−confidence level; z is solved in real time by the built-in normal inverse function rather than looked up in a table; this page outputs only the lower and upper bounds. Validation: same as above; mandatory via input guards and must be valid. Criteria: no fixed grading; the higher the confidence level, the larger z and the wider the interval; quadrupling the sample size halves the half-width.
map.标准差不能为负，样本量必须是 ≥1 的整数，置信水平须在 0–100% 之间（不: The standard deviation cannot be negative, the sample size must be an integer ≥1, and the confidence level must be between 0% and 100% (exclusive).
map.⚠ 标准差不能为负，样本量必须是 ≥1 的整数，置信水平须在 0–100% 之间: ⚠ The standard deviation cannot be negative, the sample size must be an integer ≥1, and the confidence level must be between 0% and 100% (exclusive).

map.Confidence interval（本页代码口径）：总体标准差未知时 CI=: Confidence interval (this page's convention): when population SD is unknown, CI = x̄ ± t·s/√n with df = n−1 and n ≥ 2; when population SD is known, CI = x̄ ± z·s/√n. The critical value is solved from the confidence level; lower = x̄ − critical·s/√n, upper = x̄ + critical·s/√n. Validation: all fields must be finite, n must be an integer; the t interval requires n ≥ 2. Behavior: the interval widens with s and narrows with √n; higher confidence widens it.
map.均值置信区间以样本均值 x̄ 为中心，加上/减去临界值乘标准误 s/√n。总体标: The mean confidence interval is centered on x̄ and adds/subtracts the critical value times the standard error s/√n. Use the t distribution when the population SD is unknown, with df = n−1 and n ≥ 2; use Z when it is known. The two-sided 95% Z critical value is about 1.96; t is slightly larger depending on df.
map.置信区间判读（与上式互补）：总体未知用 CI=x̄±t₁₋α/₂,df·s÷√n: Reading the interval (complements the formulas above): with unknown population SD use CI = x̄ ± t(1−α/2, df)·s/√n; with known SD use CI = x̄ ± z(1−α/2)·s/√n, where α = 1 − confidence level. This page outputs the method and the lower/upper bounds. Validation: fields must be finite and n an integer; the t interval requires n ≥ 2. Behavior: higher confidence means a larger critical value and a wider interval; quadrupling n roughly halves the half-width.

map.输入样本均值 x̄、标准差 s、样本量 n 与置信水平；总体标准差未知时默认 t: Inputs are sample mean x̄, standard deviation s, sample size n and confidence level. When the population SD is unknown the default is the t interval; when known, switch to the Z interval.
map.输出只有下限与上限：x̄ ± 临界值 × s/√n。: Only the lower and upper bounds are output: x̄ ± critical value × s/√n.
map.s 越大区间越宽，n 越大标准误越小、区间越窄；置信水平越高临界值越大。: A larger s widens the interval; a larger n shrinks the standard error and narrows the interval; a higher confidence level raises the critical value.
map.改为总体标准差已知（Z 区间）: Switch to known population SD (Z interval)
map.同组数据切换为 Z 区间：z=1.9600，半宽≈1.7892，区间 [48.2: Same data with the Z interval: z = 1.9600, half-width ≈ 1.7892, interval [48.2108, 51.7892], slightly narrower than the t interval.
map.为什么默认用 t 而不是 Z？: Why is t the default instead of Z?
map.s 是由样本估计的，n=30 时 df=29，t 临界略大于 z；只有总体 σ: s is estimated from the sample; with n = 30, df = 29, so the t critical value is slightly larger than z. Use Z directly only when the population σ is known. They converge for large n.
map.95% 置信区间是说真值有 95% 概率落在区间内吗？: Does a 95% confidence interval mean the true value has a 95% probability of lying inside it?
map.不是。它描述重复抽样所得区间的长期覆盖率；对一次已算出的区间，真值要么在内要么在: No. It describes the long-run coverage rate of intervals from repeated sampling; for one computed interval the true value is either inside or outside. The interval estimates the population mean, not the range of individual observations.
